Start-a-micro-business 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Provides step-by-step guide to start a micro-business with $0-100 and no connections.
- Focuses on practical, service-based, and skill-based business models anyone can launch within a week.
- Includes real-world examples with pricing and vetted resources for legal/tax basics.
- Offers actionable instructions for finding your first paying customer fast.
- Designed for immediate, realistic income generation—not traditional entrepreneurship.
